YMCA OF MONTREAL 


John W. McGiffin, president of Canada Steamship Lines, 
has been named general chairman of the 1967 subscription campaign 
of the Montreal YMCA. Albert L. Fairley, Jr., president of 
Hollinger Consolidated Gold Mines, will serve as special names 


chairman. 


Financial objective of the campaign, which is to run 


February 13-27, is $320,000. 


"Our campaign slogan, 'In Step With The Times,' is not 


just a catchphrase," says Mr. McGiffin. "The Y is doing a job with 
youth that urgently needs doing, and going about it in a practical, 


down-to-earth way." 


Continued 


Mr. Fairley, who has already started campaigning 
actively, says that'Helping young people to. sort. out conflicting 
issues and ideas by helping put them in their proper perspective 


is a key objective of the Y." 


Division campaign chairmen are: .W.J.H.. Fair, Downtown; 
J.M. Anderson, Northwestern;. B.A. Burgess, International; F.W. 
Davidson, Lakeshore; W.A. Devereaux, Northmount; W.L. Ridley, 
Westmount; G.T.L.. Andrews, Lachine-Dorval; F.G. Peterson, Verdun- 


LaSalle. 


= 8 z 


January 16, 1967.
